# EmptyOS Apps

> 66 apps · 17 plugins · 16 capabilities · release v0.5.7.
>
> The apps that ship in a public EmptyOS release (`core` + `standard` tiers).

Live inventory is authoritative — run `eos app list`, or `eos app info <id>` for any app's
self-generated docs. This catalog is regenerated from manifests by
`scripts/generate_apps_doc.py`; see [DOC-SYSTEM.md](DOC-SYSTEM.md).

## Core — minimum OS (always installed)

*13 apps.*

| App | What it does | Capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| **hub** | Combines panel content from installed apps into one hub | think |
| **link** | Finds and manages links between your notes | read, search, think |
| **note** | Create, read, list, and update your notes | read, write, search, think |
| **providers** | Manage local models, cloud APIs, and Claude CLI in the live capability chain | think |
| **quick-action** | Turns one input into the right capture, routing, or action | read, write, think |
| **run** | Execute shell commands and scripts locally | think |
| **search** | Searches your vault and answers questions using AI | read, search, think |
| **settings** | View and manage EmptyOS settings | — |
| **store** | Browse, install, and uninstall local apps, plugins, and skills for your account | — |
| **system-log** | Shows all system and app events in one place | think |
| **task** | Add, complete, and search tasks across your notes | read, write, think |
| **vault-backup** | Creates scheduled vault snapshots with retention rules and alerts when backups become outdated | — |
| **weather** | Shows the weather using multiple forecast sources with automatic fallback | — |

## Standard — full builder OS

*53 apps.*

| App | What it does | Capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| **agent** | Runs a permission-gated AI agent that uses tools in terminal and web | think |
| **app-analytics** | Tracks app usage and vault health to show what to fix or delete | think, search |
| **assistant** | Helps you search your vault, compare agents, and use voice conversations | think, read, write, search, speak, listen, browse |
| **billing** | Tracks token usage, daily stats, and budget alerts | write, think |
| **boards** | Organizes work in flexible boards with multiple views, automations, and offline export | read, write, think |
| **bookme** | Share your availability and let others book meetings on a self-hosted scheduling page | send |
| **braindump** | Dump a pile of mixed thoughts (type or speak) — it summarizes, splits them into tasks / journal / notes, and proposes each for your review. Triggered, never always-on | listen, think, read, write |
| **calendar** | Shows your schedule by combining tasks, journal entries, and external events | think |
| **codoc** | Bridge to the live co-doc collaboration service — persist a live doc snapshot into the vault | write, read |
| **commons** | Publish vault notes to a shared commons with visibility control — public, private, or shared with specific people. Outbound is consent-gated and leak-scanned; nothing leaves the vault without an explicit publish | read, write |
| **company** | Manage organizations with human and AI members, and run simulated team scenarios | read, write, think |
| **daily-brief** | Summarizes selected feeds with AI into one daily note | think, read, write |
| **designer** | Creates styled standalone HTML page mockups from your prompts and chosen design systems | think, read, write, artifact |
| **dictation** | Hold a hotkey in any text field and speak — your words are transcribed, lightly polished (punctuation, casing, your custom terms preserved), and inserted at the caret. Works in any EmptyOS input, textarea, or rich editor. Speak to create, type to refine | think, listen, write |
| **expense** | Track, summarize, and analyze your spending | think |
| **focus** | Times focused work sessions and suggests tasks to tackle next | think, write |
| **forge** | Scaffold and track native apps whose code lives outside the daemon | read, write |
| **garden** | Creates a programmatic SVG garden reflecting your vault entities across four wellbeing plots | read |
| **geocode** | Looks up addresses and coordinates using OpenStreetMap geocoding | — |
| **git** | Tracks versions of your notes and projects so you can review or restore changes | think |
| **github-connector** | Syncs GitHub issues and pull requests into EmptyOS projects | read, write |
| **hands-free** | Control EmptyOS by raising your hand, speaking, then confirming with a gesture | think |
| **journal** | Capture journal entries, milestones, moods, and reflections over time | read, write, search, think |
| **kb** | concepts, formulas, standards, cases, lessons, and prescriptive guidelines | read, write, think, draw, search |
| **learn** | Turns your notes into structured courses with lessons, quizzes, and progress tracking | think, read, write |
| **life** | one day timeline composed from journal, worklog, and expense. Owns no data; member apps contribute items via [[contributes.life.timeline]] | — |
| **music-library** | Browse, play, and edit songs in your vault, and generate AI lyrics | read, write, search, think |
| **people** | Manage people, relationships, workload, capacity, birthdays, and interaction history | read, write, search, think |
| **portal** | Routes thinking, capture, search, and learning into organized rooms with shared context | — |
| **ppt** | Create presentations from Markdown notes, present fullscreen, and export standalone HTML | read, write, think, draw, speak |
| **proactive** | a restrained engine that scans your state for things worth surfacing (deadlines, journaling gaps, today's load, budget overruns) and nudges you through a quiet-hours + frequency-capped gate | — |
| **projects** | Scans your vault to parse project status and track progress | read, write, search, think, artifact |
| **publish** | Publishes vault notes as a static website for blogs, projects, or a digital garden | read, write, think, search, draw, browse |
| **quotes** | Shows a random inspirational quote from your stored collection each day | think, read, write |
| **reactor** | Manages the system's internal activity and state changes | think |
| **reader** | Reads books with AI scene visualization, concept maps, and dictionary lookup | read, write, think, search, speak, draw |
| **replay** | turn a finished agent session into a reusable, parameterized Replay (a saved workflow), then run it again later with every state-changing step routed through the review gate. Demonstrate once, replay safely | think, read, write |
| **reports** | Creates structured technical reports, proposals, and specs with signoff and PDF/DOCX export | think |
| **rooms** | Create persistent one-on-one or shared AI rooms with prompts, files, and history | think, read, write |
| **routing** | Plans multi-stop routes for trip planning using cached OSRM directions | — |
| **runbook** | Builds, schedules, and publishes typed block pipelines | read, write, think |
| **scroll** | Shows an AI-generated short video feed tailored to your chosen personas | read, write, think, speak, draw |
| **sheet** | a grid of cells with per-cell formulas (=SUM, =IF, =TODAY), stored as a markdown table in a vault note | read, write |
| **tour** | Guides you through EmptyOS features with interactive steps across real screens | — |
| **vault-graph** | Visualizes your vault notes, links, and references as an interactive graph | read |
| **video-digest** | Queue YouTube or web URLs and turn them into vault Web-Clip digests with AI-distilled summaries | think, read, write, browse |
| **viz** | Creates standalone visual explainers, diagrams, charts, and Three.js scenes from plain-language briefs | think, read, write |
| **vlog** | record or import a clip a day, auto-transcribed and laid out on a calendar, with an optional compile-to-montage | read, write, listen |
| **voice-assistant** | Talks with you by listening, thinking, and speaking back | think, listen, speak, browse, translate |
| **worklog** | project-grouped, status-tagged daily entries | read, write, think |
| **worklog-capture** | screenshot or hotkey in the moment, then batch-review AI-drafted entries into your worklog. Cross-checks screenshots with your AI-session and browser trail. Triggered, never ambient; local-first | read, write, think |
| **workspaces** | Organizes related apps into navigable spaces around a goal | think |
| **writing-editor** | large-print documents with voice dictation and PDF export, plus draft revision with audience + tone awareness | think, read, write, listen |

---

**Personal apps** (`apps/personal/`) are gitignored and machine-specific — never listed here.
Every app follows `manifest.toml` + `app.py` (+ optional `pages/`). Apps without `pages/`
get an auto-generated UI. See [APP-DEVELOPMENT.md](APP-DEVELOPMENT.md).
